title: test: move gen tests out of src
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the three remaining Gen test files from `src/` to `test/`.
- Updates import paths only; test behavior and runtime code are unchanged.
- Verified with Biome, Gen typecheck, and all 126 tests in the moved files.

gist.headline: Tests found a new hive
gist.blurb: Three Gen test files moved from src/ to test/, where tests can continue doing their favorite activity: checking things repeatedly.
gist.summary: Moved byop-markup, community-endpoints, and model-registry tests from gen.pollinations.ai/src to test/ with import-path updates only; runtime behavior is unchanged.
gist.impact: Developers get a cleaner separation between Gen runtime code and its 126-test suite, with no API or user-visible behavior changes.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tidies three labeled test scrolls from a code shelf into a cozy test-library nook while a small CRT robot verifies them with a green checkmark; tiny code-plants show that the runtime garden remains untouched.
